EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
THE following Order made by the Minister of Finance, in pursuance of the powers vested in him by Section 2 of theRevenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962, is hereby published for general information.

Whereas the Cabinet of Ministers had decided that a resolution should be introduced in Parliament, being aresolution which will have the effect of altering the rates of Import Duty of the articles specified in Column 3 of theSchedule hereto, and deleting the existing List of Concessions and the List of Exemptions under the Provisions of ScheduleA of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and substituting therefore the List of Concessions and the List of Exemptionsin the Schedule hereto.

By virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962, I, RaviKarunanayake, Finance Minister of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, do by this Order effective from 11thNovember, 2016 :
